children: Worthington Enterprises Inc. (WOR) filed a Form 8K - Direct or off-Balance Sheet Financial Obligation - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on August 31, 2026.

See the description in Item 1.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K, related to the Fifth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement entered into on the Effective Date, which description is incorporated herein by reference.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/108516/000119312526376705/wor-20260831.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/108516/000119312526376705/0001193125-26-376705-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
